concerns.text: The cited OpenNeuro dataset (`ds004xxx`) accessed via `https://huggingface.co/datasets/clane9/openneuro-fslr64k/…` appears to be an fMRI (or imaging) dataset rather than the required open‑access electrophysiology recordings with spike counts and trial‑level behavioral logs. FR‑001 and FR‑009 require spike‑sorted neural data (`spike_counts`) and trial success rates, which this dataset does not provide, making it inappropriate for the core drift‑quantification pipeline.
